# PHILGEPS OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING
Date: August 24, 2026

## BEST OPPORTUNITIES
Match rating: STRONG MATCH
Score: 8/10
Project: Development, Integration, and Deployment of a Municipal Treasury and Accounting System, and Customization of Automatic Taxpayer Short Message Service (SMS) Notification
Procuring entity: Municipality of Talugtug, Nueva Ecija
Reference number: 13202873
ABC: PHP 300,000.00
Deadline: Header: August 24, 2026 12:00 PM; Description: submit proposals on or before August 25, 2026
Procurement method: Negotiated Procurement - Small Value Procurement (Sec. 34) / Request for Expression of Interest
Why it fits AIStaff: Direct fit for AIStaff custom systems and automated notifications. Small-value procurement and the notice explicitly allows PhilGEPS Platinum or Red membership.
Important requirements: Valid PhilGEPS Certificate of Registration (Platinum/Red Membership); Mayor's/Business Permit; Notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement; Secretary's Certificate or SPA if represented; 120 calendar days delivery upon Notice to Proceed
Risks or blockers: Deadline inconsistency between the notice header and description must be clarified before spending effort; Treasury/accounting domain expectations may require accounting workflow depth beyond AIStaff's current packaged offers; The public abstract does not include the TOR attachments in the crawl, so final scope still needs confirmation
Recommended next action: Call or email BAC immediately today to confirm the true submission deadline and request the full TOR/eligibility packet before deciding whether to quote.
Official PhilGEPS link: https://notices.philgeps.gov.ph/GEPSNONPILOT/Tender/SplashBidNoticeAbstractUI.aspx?BusCatID=43&DirectFrom=OpenOpp&Type=category&menuIndex=3&refID=13202873

Match rating: POSSIBLE MATCH
Score: 5/10
Project: Acquisition of Bureau of Immigration's SMS Notification System
Procuring entity: Bureau of Immigration
Reference number: 13180354
ABC: PHP 8,122,850.31
Deadline: September 2, 2026 12:00 PM
Procurement method: Public Bidding / Invitation to Bid
Why it fits AIStaff: Relevant to AIStaff's automated notification and messaging capability, especially for outbound alerts and workflow-triggered messaging.
Important requirements: Manual submission at the BAC Secretariat in Intramuros; Pre-bid conference already held on August 19, 2026; Bid documents require separate request by email
Risks or blockers: Public bidding at this value usually implies prior similar contracts, bid security, and heavier compliance even if the abstract does not spell them out; Government-grade SMS infrastructure at immigration scale is materially larger than AIStaff's current reference scope; No explicit Red-friendly or new-supplier-friendly language in the public abstract
Recommended next action: Pursue only if AIStaff can document comparable messaging-system delivery and can absorb full public-bidding compliance quickly.
Official PhilGEPS link: https://notices.philgeps.gov.ph/GEPSNONPILOT/Tender/SplashBidNoticeAbstractUI.aspx?BusCatID=10&DirectFrom=OpenOpp&Type=category&menuIndex=3&refID=13180354

## URGENT DEADLINES
Project: Municipal Treasury and Accounting System with SMS Notification
Procuring entity: Municipality of Talugtug, Nueva Ecija
Reference number: 13202873
Deadline: Conflicting dates: August 24, 2026 12:00 PM in header vs August 25, 2026 in description
Why urgent: Urgent only because the notice is a real fit and the deadline conflict could immediately disqualify a bid if not clarified.


## NOT RECOMMENDED
- Three (3) Years Subscription to Messaging Suite (SMS OTP and Text Blast Facility) (LANDBANK OF THE PHILIPPINES - HEAD OFFICE; Ref 13196530) - Technically relevant, but the notice explicitly requires similar completed contracts within five years and the PHP 49.7M bank-scale scope is far beyond a practical AIStaff first government bid.
  Official PhilGEPS link: https://notices.philgeps.gov.ph/GEPSNONPILOT/Tender/SplashBidNoticeAbstractUI.aspx?BusCatID=10&DirectFrom=OpenOpp&Type=category&menuIndex=3&refID=13196530
- Implementation of Integrated Health Management Information System (City of Muntinlupa; Ref 13202607) - Huge PHP 38.3M integrated health-system implementation with full public-bidding compliance. Too large, too regulated, and too risky for a new government supplier.
  Official PhilGEPS link: https://notices.philgeps.gov.ph/GEPSNONPILOT/Tender/SplashBidNoticeAbstractUI.aspx?BusCatID=10&DirectFrom=OpenOpp&Type=category&menuIndex=3&refID=13202607
- Procurement of Consultancy Services to Support the Supply, Delivery, Development, Implementation, and Training of the Integrated Financial Management Information System (IFMIS) (Philippine National Railways; Ref 13206420) - Relevant on paper, but the PHP 48.7M IFMIS transformation scope clearly points to an experienced enterprise integrator with a large delivery team and prior government credentials.
  Official PhilGEPS link: https://notices.philgeps.gov.ph/GEPSNONPILOT/Tender/SplashBidNoticeAbstractUI.aspx?BusCatID=43&DirectFrom=OpenOpp&Type=category&menuIndex=3&refID=13206420
- Acquisition of Software Development Tools Licenses (Bureau of Immigration; Ref 13180357) - This is a software-license resale/procurement opportunity, not an AIStaff services engagement.
  Official PhilGEPS link: https://notices.philgeps.gov.ph/GEPSNONPILOT/Tender/SplashBidNoticeAbstractUI.aspx?BusCatID=10&DirectFrom=OpenOpp&Type=category&menuIndex=3&refID=13180357
- One (1) year Subscription of Enterprise Resource Management - School Management System (Municipality of Glan, Sarangani Province; Ref 13200626) - Potentially software-related, but the notice reads like a defined school ERP product subscription with centralized database, replication, RFID attendance, and institution-specific module depth that likely favors an established niche vendor.
  Official PhilGEPS link: https://notices.philgeps.gov.ph/GEPSNONPILOT/Tender/SplashBidNoticeAbstractUI.aspx?BusCatID=10&DirectFrom=OpenOpp&Type=category&menuIndex=3&refID=13200626

## TODAY'S RECOMMENDATION
Best opportunity to pursue: Municipality of Talugtug treasury/accounting system with SMS notification
Documents AIStaff should prepare: PhilGEPS Red or Platinum certificate; Mayor's/Business Permit; Notarized Omnibus Sworn Statement; Secretary's Certificate or SPA for the signatory; 1-2 page capability statement focused on custom systems and automated notifications; A short list of relevant private-sector implementations and references
Clarifications to request from the BAC: Which deadline controls: the header deadline of August 24, 2026 12:00 PM or the description deadline of August 25, 2026; Whether Red membership is fully acceptable for this procurement without Platinum-only restrictions in attachments; Whether the municipality expects a full accounting platform replacement, enhancement of an existing system, or a limited module deployment; Whether SMS gateway/subscription cost should be included in the quoted ABC and what volume is expected
